name: Cargo bike
description: How far an electric cargo tricycle gets out and back on one battery charge, over the hills and preferring bike lanes, and what it saves against a car (purchase, fuel, tax, insurance, parking, maintenance), in its own tab.

calculations.label: Cargo bike range
calculations.description: Round trip from a start point to a destination on bike-usable streets (preferring bike lanes) with the battery used over the terrain, and a range map of how far the bike gets out and back in every direction.

calculations.label: Cargo bike savings
calculations.description: Yearly cost of the cargo bike against a car for the same trips: purchase, energy, tax, insurance, parking and maintenance, in the currency of the start point's country.
